g.text: Header: Workflow ID, Run ID, status, actions
Summary: input and result, with the
event history as a timeline or an event list
- The event is the unit you read
- Operations beyond the plugin: Reset, batch,
Header: Workflow ID, Run ID, Run 2 of 3, status,
one box per step: Activity (x3 attempts),
- The step is the unit you read
- Large payloads read back from S3
- Anything missing: Open in Temporal UI
